title: crassocephalum rubens
intro: Crassocephalum rubens, commonly known as Red Land Cress, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include treating fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions. The therapeutic actions of Crassocephalum rubens are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its ability to reduce pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
